name: Taurob Inspector V8
summary: An Austrian ATEX Zone 1 tracked inspection robot (92 kg, IP67, -20 to +60 °C) with a four-joint arm that lifts a 4K camera up to 1.64 m, climbs stairs up to 45° and runs 4 h missions; ADNOC uses it for autonomous inspections at a gas plant in Abu Dhabi.

germany.statusNote: Sold directly by Taurob GmbH in Vienna on request ("I'm interested" / contact page); the maker states "Available within 1 month". No price published.

specs.label: Mission runtime
specs.conditions: full charge in 90 min, 20-80% in 45 min; stand-by about 6.5 h
specs.quote: The Inspector performs missions of up to 4 uninterrupted hours and recharges in only 90 minutes to its full capacity.

specs.label: Explosion protection
specs.value: ATEX Zone 1, intrinsically safe; ATEX Zone 1 docking

specs.label: Stairs
specs.quote: The Inspector climbs and descends stairs of up to 45° inclination

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: 4 x 2K cameras (360°), 4K camera in the arm, thermal camera, 3D LIDAR, microphone; gas-finding camera and multi-gas sensor as payload
specs.quote: It captures ultra-high-definition photos and videos, records sounds, identifies gas leaks through thermography, and surveys its surroundings with a 3D LIDAR scanner.

specs.label: Software
specs.value: Flexible API; EasyDriveWeb, EasyMission and Admiralty fleet software; integrations with Energy Robotics, Yokogawa, DroneDeploy and others
specs.quote: Taurob’s flexible API connects directly to a client’s digital twin or seamlessly integrates 3rd party software.

notes: The arm is a four-joint sensor arm with a camera head for a human-height viewpoint; it does not grip. A gripping "operator" robot is being co-developed separately (ARGOS project).
Surfaces named by the maker: grated floors, concrete, grass, gravel, sand, ramps and stairs up to 45°.
Built for oil and gas, power, chemical and mining sites; needs nitrogen purging gas and 100-240 VAC at the site.

evidence.task: Autonomous routine inspections in hazardous areas of a gas compression plant (gas leaks, hotspots)
evidence.where: Taweelah Gas Compression Plant, Abu Dhabi, UAE
evidence.note: ADNOC: "autonomous advanced robots are already deployed in live operations".

researchEvidence.quote: The Inspector climbs and descends stairs of up to 45° inclination
Gaps, steps and uneven surfaces overcoming
Built for the extreme, the Inspector serves dutifully in harsh industrial environments, explosive atmospheres, adverse weather conditions and all sorts of terrain.
